overview: The Fungal Forest is a bioluminescent cavern ecosystem fed by arcane vents and Shissar nutrient scars. Shrieker broods dominate the biome.
history: The Shissar cultivated early fungal strains for bio-arcana experiments.
Arcane vents beneath the caverns accelerated fungal growth.
Shrieker broods evolved into semi-sentient fungal predators.
Void fractures tainted parts of the forest with corrupted spores.
Thought Horrors began using the forest as a psychic hunting ground.
hooks: Void spores corrupt a large section of the forest.
Shissar remnants attempt to reclaim nutrient scars.
Thought Horrors hunt through the fungal tunnels.
